title: Kili AI
summary: Ad marketplace that earns developers back their inference costs by showing ads while an AI agent is 'thinking'.
highlights: Developers keep [[50%]] of net ad revenue, paid in stablecoins or through Stripe
Intent-matched ads shown only during natural wait states, never over the work
One-command install for Claude Code and AI apps; [[250+]] daily active users

title: Scribble Brands
summary: AI visibility platform that tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Grok cite a brand, then helps it get cited more.
highlights: RocketX grew AI citation share from [[2% to 20%]] across 25 priority queries in 3 months
Audit, create, amplify: citation tracking, competitor benchmarks, and a content hub in one dashboard
Creator bounties to [[50,000+]] creators, paid only when AI cites them; [[6,000+]] pieces cited

title: Scribble Creators
summary: Campaign platform where creators write for brands and get paid.
highlights: [[50,000+]] active creators, [[800+]] brand campaigns
[[$500,000+]] paid out, [[72%]] average win rate
Submit from X, Reddit, Medium, and Substack; paid on-platform

title: Rabotics
summary: One-click bots that put crypto to work in DeFi yield strategies.
highlights: One click replaces the multi-step DeFi research that overwhelms beginners
Deposits and withdrawals across Aerodrome, Curve, Morpho, and more

title: Faucet
summary: Service that sends crypto payouts to creators and test tokens to wallets across Base, Monad, and Sepolia.
highlights: Strategy-per-token drips for ETH, USDC, and partner campaign tokens
Pays creators and funds testnet wallets on Base, Monad, and Sepolia

title: Hermes
summary: Internal notification microservice for branded Email, Discord, and Twitter messages.
highlights: One service for email, Discord, and Twitter messages across products
Powers magic-link login, payout receipts, and weekly brand reports

title: Mimir
summary: Go metrics scraper that pulls weekly Twitter engagement and GitHub activity for creator scoring.
highlights: Scrapes Twitter and GitHub in parallel instead of one API call at a time
Weekly engagement and repo activity for creator scoring

title: Go-Vault
summary: CLI for backing up and restoring PostgreSQL databases to local disk or AWS S3.
highlights: Interactive CLI for PostgreSQL dump and restore
Local disk or AWS S3 storage, with backup metadata in BoltDB

title: Tusk
summary: Go CLI that turns one-off commands into systemd timers, with intervals or CRON expressions.
highlights: Writes and enables systemd service and timer files for you
Intervals from seconds to years, or CRON; streams journalctl logs

title: GitOpener
summary: Beginner-friendly open source platform that teaches contributing through live guides and GitHub auth.
highlights: MDX guides and auto-generated contributor profiles
GitHub sign-in; built with [[zero AI]] code
